nar.text: On Sunday it was warm and overcast.
Arcangeli breaks his Talbot's differential at the start as Nuvolari and Varzi shoot into the lead.
After the first lap, as the cars came past the finish, Varzi appeared first and completed the lap at an average speed of 129.276 km/h.
Varzi punctures and loses about seven minutes; Nuvolari leads with a record 11m41s lap.
After three laps Nuvolari passed the grandstand in new record time of 11m31s at 136.385 km/h average speed, followed by Borzacchini and Brilli Peri.
At the end of lap four Nuvolari still held the lead but just a few meters behind his car lurked Brilli Peri and Borzacchini, ready for attack.
Cracchi retired his 1500 Bugatti.
Brilli Peri takes the lead with a record 11m03.2s, 13 seconds ahead of Nuvolari and 41 ahead of Borzacchini.
Brilli Peri sets a new fastest lap of 11m00.6s.
On lap seven Brilli Peri stopped at his pit to refuel and had problems restarting the Talbot's hot engine.
Borzacchini, who stopped on the same lap for fuel, rejoined the race in first place.
Varzi, who had been driving at the back of the field, retired with a fractured fuel tank, caused by the bumpy road.
After ten laps Borzacchini held what looked like a secure lead of 1m42s in his fast Maserati.
Brilli Peri has passed Nuvolari, who has ignition trouble.
After the eleventh lap Borzacchini was still 1m20s ahead of Brilli Peri who had made up 22 seconds.
Nuvolari in third place had to stop at his pit losing seven minutes to attend to ignition problems with his Bugatti.
After lap 12, Borzacchini's lead was down to 40 seconds, since Brilli had made up 40 seconds in one lap.
Brilli Peri laps in 10m56s, a new fastest lap.
At the end of 14 laps, Brilli Peri led Borzacchini by eight seconds, followed by Nuvolari, Ruggeri, Cleto Nenzioni, Fisauli, and Gian Nenzioni.
On this lap Cortese retired with engine problems.
After 16 laps Brilli Peri finished first to great applause by the cheering crowd.
Borzacchini second and 2000 cc class winner; Nuvolari third, ahead of Ruggeri and Cleto Nenzioni.
